name: io.github.belermirzaa7-ops/sec-edgar-mcp
title: SEC EDGAR
description: Read-only MCP server for SEC EDGAR: XBRL financials, filing text and tables, segment breakdowns, full-text search, insider and institutional ownership

environmentVariables.name: SEC_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Identifies you to SEC as their fair-access policy requires; must contain an email address. The server refuses to start without it.

environmentVariables.name: SEC_RATE_LIMIT_PER_SEC
environmentVariables.description: Requests per second sent to SEC. Defaults to 8, below SEC's published ceiling of 10. Raising it risks a block.
